query: Build a bridge (BTL) power amplifier in Multisim: single 19.5 V supply, 8 Ohm load, TIP121/TIP127 output transistors, 1 kHz sine input. Add 5 analyses in Batched (operating point, gain at 1 kHz, frequency response, harmonics and THD, noise) and a circuit description with the results of the analyses.
answers: If asked for the original schematic, say: take a classic bridge amplifier from the literature.
expected_behavior: Updates the skill first and states its version in one line
Supply is really 19.5 V in the file: the build report line `supply:` shows 19.5 V (DC_POWER or vcc(volts=19.5)), not the 5 V default
The output stage is biased so that it conducts at rest (enough diode drops or a Vbe multiplier for Darlingtons, emitter resistors), or the answer says plainly that it is class B
Every expected value comes from spice.run (or spice.py) on the built file; the values in the chat and in the description match a re-run on the file
The supply current is an analysis variable (I(V1) of a DC_POWER source)
Fourier max step is at most 1 us for 1 kHz and 9 harmonics; AC sweep has about 100 points per decade
The description has no markup left as text (#, ###, **, K_U) and describes exactly this file
build() report: overlaps none and check: READY; no warning is called cosmetic
Asks which pictures to put into the description before inserting any
